auth.sayHi: Welcome to the Zalo License Management Website.
auth.subtitleLogin: Manage license keys, devices, and user accounts.
auth.subtitleRegister: Register a new account for the license admin system.
auth.deviceMismatch: This account is registered to another device. Please use the original device or contact support.

adminLicenses.legacyNoPlain: created before full key storage; create a new key to get a copyable value
adminLicenses.keysCreatedHint: Copy these keys now. They will not be shown again.
adminLicenses.customKeyHint: Leave blank to auto-generate a random key. Minimum 8 characters.
adminLicenses.customKeyForcesSingle: A custom key can only create 1 license at a time.
adminLicenses.duplicateKey: License key already exists. Please enter a different key.
adminLicenses.durationStartsAtActivation: This duration applies from the end user's first activation, not from when you create the key.

adminUsers.confirmResetDevice: Remove the bound device from this account? The next login will register a new device.
adminUsers.deviceReset: Device unbound. The account can now log in from another device.

pages.noteOverviewAdmin: Numbers refresh when you open this page. Use Licenses to create keys and manage devices.
pages.noteOverviewUser: Activate your key under My License. Contact admin if you need a new key or device reset.
pages.noteLicensePlaceholder: License module is being implemented in upcoming steps.
pages.noteBackendPending: Frontend currently uses mock auth, real backend will be wired in next steps.
pages.placeholderBody: This page is a placeholder. It will be wired to the backend in upcoming steps.
pages.myLicenseSubtitle: Activate and verify your license on this device.
pages.myLicenseDeviceHint: The Chrome extension and this website each have their own device ID (extension uses chrome.storage; the site uses this browser). If you activated the key in the extension, Verify here may fail until you open this page with the same ID — have the extension open the dashboard with ?deviceId=… or activate again here (uses another device slot if your plan allows).
pages.licenseValidityExplain: Expiry is counted from your first activation of this key, not from when the admin created it. Until someone activates the key, the period does not run.
pages.noLicenseYet: You don't have a license yet.
pages.purchaseError: Could not start purchase. Please try again.
pages.purchaseOpened: Payment instructions are ready. Transfer the exact amount with the memo shown below.
pages.pendingOrderBannerDesc: Amount: {{amount}} — transfer memo: {{content}}. Finish this payment or cancel it to start a new order.
pages.orderCancelled: Order cancelled. You can now start a new purchase.
pages.orderCancelFailed: Could not cancel the order. Please try again.
pages.orderExpired: This order has expired. Please close and buy again.
pages.pkg1dAlreadyPurchased: The 1-day trial package can only be purchased once per account.
pages.pendingOrderReused: You already have a payment in progress. Use the same QR and transfer memo until it is confirmed — do not start a second transfer for a new order.
pages.purchaseSubtitle: Pick a plan and pay via bank transfer. After SePay confirms your transfer, an unused license key is created automatically.
pages.qrUnavailable: No QR image URL from the server. Set SEPAY_QR_BANK (+ account), or VIETQR_* for VietQR.io, or SEPAY_CHECKOUT_QR_URL for a static image.
pages.purchasePaid: Payment received. Open My License to activate your new key.
pages.purchasedUnusedHint: Preview: {{preview}}. Open My License, paste the full key from your payment confirmation email or admin, then Activate.
pages.purchasedUnusedHintShort: Copy the license key below, paste it on the left (or use the pre-filled value), then Activate.
pages.adminTestPurchaseHint: These packages are for testing the payment flow. Use the admin-confirm endpoint if SePay webhook is not set up.

pkg1d.a1: Try it out for a day
